Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with the LCD screen, control dials, and viewfinder; 'Canon' is visible on the grip.
Photo 2 shows the bottom of the camera with the battery compartment and serial number area; 'Canon' is visible on the grip and the bottom plate.
All photos show the camera on a glass surface with a yellow box labeled 'HAMMZ GLOBAL SERVICES' in the background.

claims.claim: US Used Canon 80D Camera body in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: The model is confirmed from the photos, but there is no visual proof of the camera being in working condition. No power-on test, screen display, or function demonstration is shown.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have functional defects (e.g., shutter failure, sensor issues, LCD damage).
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, shutter operation, and live view on the LCD screen.

risks.risk: Camera may have hidden physical damage (e.g., cracked sensor, internal dust, or mold) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up video of the sensor with the lens removed, or a photo of the sensor under magnification.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential sensor issues

risks.risk: Camera may have been stolen or imported illegally (common with US-used electronics in Nigeria).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number and a proof of purchase or import documentation.

proof_requests: Video showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and shutter operation.
Close-up photo or video of the sensor with lens removed.
Clear photo of the serial number and proof of purchase if available.
response.reason: The model is confirmed as Canon EOS 80D, but the working condition cannot be verified from the photos alone. Functional and hidden physical risks require proof before pricing can be determined.
